verdict.rationale: Bevy is a code-first engine: all engine and game logic runs through the Bevy ECS Rust API, and Bevy is added as a normal cargo dependency, so there is no separate editor UI holding capabilities the API lacks. The runtime probe confirms an agent can drive the whole cargo workflow without an editor, and notes a first-party Bevy Remote Protocol for runtime access. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of API/UI parity or Remote Protocol coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven workflows; pre-1.0 breaking changes also make the API a moving target for agents.
